text: Ironvale Athletic start a counter-attack after Jonah Lindgren intercepts the ball near their own left side. He passes the ball forward to Aiden Morales in the middle of the field, who then passes to Teo Quinlan. Quinlan carries the ball forward near the centre-right flank and makes a through pass into the right edge of the penalty area where Jonah Lindqvist receives it. Lindqvist moves closer, about 9 metres from the Redmond Rovers goal on the right side, and shoots with his foot to score, putting Ironvale Athletic ahead 1-0 at the Redmond Rovers end [#40] [#41] [#42] [#43] [#44] [#45] [#46] [#47] [#48] [#50].
